text:
Type: four-drawer storage chest
Use: storing toys, clothes, papers and supplies in drawers; children's room, bedroom, home office
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: white laminated board, flat drawer fronts with cut-out finger grips
Colors: white, black grip insets
Shape: compact square box with four stacked full-width drawers, rectangular cut-out handles, flat top, sits directly on the floor, simple and low, light visual weight
Feel: clean, tidy, practical, friendly
Goes with: light wood, white walls, pastel or bright accents; Scandinavian children's rooms, bedrooms and home offices

product.name: STUVA
product.description: Low storage makes it easier for children to reach and organise their things.
